Join our collaborative environment, where you'll contribute to our strategy and make an impact on product success. Working closely with the product management team and cross-functional partners, you contribute your skills and insights to help ensure the success of our product offerings. As a valued member of the team, you have the opportunity to learn and grow in a dynamic and fast-paced environment, making a tangible impact on our products and customer experiences.

The Product Data Analyst partners with business, engineering, design, and product teams to transform complex datasets into clear, actionable insights that drive strategic decision-making. You will anchor emerging conversational AI initiatives—leveraging modern tools to shape how stakeholders dynamically query and interact with data through highly structured semantic models and refiner tables.

Partner deeply with leadership and cross-functional teams to diagnose business friction points, scope analytics deliverables, and define core success metrics.

jobs.title: Senior Geospatial Analyst
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Geospatial Analyst based in the United States.

This role offers the opportunity to work on advanced geospatial, GIS, and remote sensing projects supporting public-sector and enterprise clients.

The position focuses on lidar processing, data analysis, quality assurance, and innovative geospatial solutions.

You will contribute to the creation of accurate mapping products while improving workflows and production processes.

The role combines technical expertise, problem-solving, and collaboration within a multidisciplinary engineering environment.

You will work with modern geospatial technologies, automation tools, and remote sensing platforms to deliver high-quality results.

The ideal candidate will bring strong lidar experience, analytical skills, and a passion for advancing geospatial capabilities.

Accountabilities

The Senior Geospatial Analyst will support the execution of complex GIS, lidar, and remote sensing projects by managing technical workflows, ensuring data accuracy, and contributing to process improvements. This role requires hands-on expertise with geospatial data processing, quality control, and collaboration with technical teams to deliver reliable client solutions.

Support lidar sensor installations, calibration activities, and boresight review processes.
Perform quality checks on acquired datasets, troubleshoot acquisition challenges, and ensure data accuracy.
Process airborne and mobile lidar trajectories using industry-standard tools and workflows.
Extract, process, classify, and analyze lidar data from raw sensor formats.
Perform lidar calibration, alignment, registration, and adjustment activities.
Conduct QA/QC reviews to ensure processed data meets accuracy standards and project requirements.
Evaluate point clouds and geospatial datasets to identify issues and validate deliverables.
Create digital mapping and remotely sensed products using various geospatial software platforms.
Support project execution by assisting with timelines, production goals, and quality objectives.
Manage geospatial data workflows, including file organization, storage, backups, and production requirements.
Ensure compliance with established quality control procedures and project documentation standards.
Provide input on standard operating procedures, workflow improvements, and automation opportunities.
Collaborate with technical teams to improve production efficiency and enhance geospatial processes.
Support multi-sensor processing, data manipulation, and geospatial product development.
Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior geospatial team members.

Requirements

The ideal candidate is an experienced geospatial professional with strong expertise in lidar technologies, GIS workflows, remote sensing, and data quality management. This role requires technical proficiency, strong communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while collaborating with multidisciplinary teams.

8+ years of experience working with imagery, topographic lidar, bathymetric lidar, data processing, analysis, and classification workflows.
Strong understanding of GIS and lidar concepts, including raster and vector data, coordinate systems, projections, and datums.
Experience with airborne lidar acquisition, processing workflows, calibration, and deliverable creation.
Knowledge of lidar error sources, trajectory processing, and sensor calibration techniques.
Experience with lidar processing tools such as Applanix PosPac MMS, NovAtel Inertial Explorer, Riegl RiProcess, Optech LMS, Teledyne CARIS, GeoCue True View EVO, or similar platforms.
Advanced knowledge of ESRI products, including ArcGIS 10x and ArcGIS Pro.
Experience analyzing point clouds and geospatial datasets derived from remote sensing technologies.
Strong quality assurance, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage multiple projects, meet deadlines, and adapt to changing priorities.
Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate across teams.
Experience mentoring, training, or supporting junior technical staff.
Familiarity with Terrasolid products, MicroStation, LASTools, LP360, Global Mapper, QGIS, GDAL tools, or command-line applications is preferred.
Working knowledge of Python or other programming languages is preferred.
Experience with automation, process improvement, GIS production editing, or data management workflows is a plus.
Surveying, geomatics, GIS, remote sensing, or related formal education is preferred.
Project management experience or certification is beneficial.
Industry certifications such as GISP, ASPRS lidar/remote sensing certifications, or NGA-related credentials are a plus.
Must be a U.S. citizen.

Benefits

Competitive annual salary range of $91,000 - $118,000, depending on experience, skills, location, and market conditions.
Remote work opportunities may be available depending on experience and business needs.
Opportunity to work on innovative geospatial and remote sensing projects.
Professional growth opportunities within a multidisciplinary technical environment.
Exposure to advanced GIS, lidar, and automation technologies.
Collaborative workplace focused on innovation, quality, and continuous improvement.
Opportunities to contribute to impactful projects supporting public-sector and commercial clients.

Brief Job Description

The Integration & Coordination (I&C) Unit serves as a single customer interface for projects requiring coordination across multiple parts of the Office of Data, Analytics, and Performance (DAP) or Health and Human Services (HHS) and is helping create processes and relationships that drive toward a strategic, agency-wide approach to data, analytics, and performance. Under the direction of I&C Unit management, the Analytic Modernization Project Coordinator works under minimal supervision and performs highly advanced (senior-level) analytic, consultative, and project management services.

Working within the Performance & Analytics Integration department, this position is responsible for planning, coordinating, and overseeing complex data and analytic modernization initiatives, such as those focused on migrating legacy databases and data assets to cloud-based environments. The Analytic Modernization Project Coordinator serves as the primary liaison among business stakeholders, data teams, information technology staff, and executive leadership to ensure successful project delivery; coordinates efforts related to cloud migration, data governance, data quality, modernization planning, risk management, stakeholder communication, and organizational change management; and supports the implementation of enterprise data strategies that improve governance, accessibility, interoperability, scalability, security, and analytical use of agency data. While this position does not require technical expertise in system modernization, understanding technical language and the ability to coordinate between technical and non-technical audiences is essential.

The position requires a strategic thinker who can balance near-term project delivery with long-term organizational objectives. The successful candidate will engage technical SMEs to effectively evaluate how individual project decisions impact enterprise architecture, data strategy, operational processes, governance frameworks, and future modernization initiatives. The successful candidate will also effectively work with SMEs to understand the history of how and why existing systems were designed, incorporating historical lessons learned and functionality into future modernization efforts. This role requires the ability to synthesize complex information, anticipate downstream impacts, identify interdependencies, and develop solutions that align with broader organizational goals.

The Analytic Modernization Project Coordinator attends work on a regular and predictable schedule in accordance with agency leave policy and performs other duties as assigned. The ideal candidate will thrive in an environment that innovates through new ideas, strives for excellence, embraces change, and supports teamwork.

Project Management and Oversight (30%)

Coordinates activities related to data warehousing, cloud data platforms, metadata management, and data governance initiatives. Brief Job Description

The Integration & Coordination (I&C) Unit serves as a single customer interface for projects requiring coordination across multiple parts of the Office of Data, Analytics, and Performance (DAP) or Health and Human Services (HHS) and is helping create processes and relationships that drive toward a strategic, agency-wide approach to data, analytics, and performance. Under the direction of I&C Unit management, the Analytic Modernization Project Coordinator works under minimal supervision and performs highly advanced (senior-level) analytic, consultative, and project management services.

Working within the Performance & Analytics Integration department, this position is responsible for planning, coordinating, and overseeing complex data and analytic modernization initiatives, such as those focused on migrating legacy databases and data assets to cloud-based environments. The Analytic Modernization Project Coordinator serves as the primary liaison among business stakeholders, data teams, information technology staff, and executive leadership to ensure successful project delivery; coordinates efforts related to cloud migration, data governance, data quality, modernization planning, risk management, stakeholder communication, and organizational change management; and supports the implementation of enterprise data strategies that improve governance, accessibility, interoperability, scalability, security, and analytical use of agency data. While this position does not require technical expertise in system modernization, understanding technical language and the ability to coordinate between technical and non-technical audiences is essential.

The position requires a strategic thinker who can balance near-term project delivery with long-term organizational objectives. The successful candidate will engage technical SMEs to effectively evaluate how individual project decisions impact enterprise architecture, data strategy, operational processes, governance frameworks, and future modernization initiatives. The successful candidate will also effectively work with SMEs to understand the history of how and why existing systems were designed, incorporating historical lessons learned and functionality into future modernization efforts.
